name: Ornate Gothic Signet Ring
shortDescription: A bold signet-style ring with carved gothic chrome-inspired detail.
description: A chunky gothic signet ring featuring deep carved motifs and oxidised recesses for high contrast. Built with a strong silhouette and a comfortable inner fit for daily wear.

name: Fleur-de-Lis Crown Ring
shortDescription: A sculpted fleur-de-lis ring with a crown-like gothic profile.
description: Inspired by cathedral ornamentation, this ring features a raised fleur-de-lis silhouette with heavy relief. Oxidised valleys create a strong, chrome-style contrast.

name: Cross & Skull Band Ring
shortDescription: A thick band ring with crosses and a skull emblem centerpiece.
description: A heavy gothic band designed with repeating cross elements and a central skull detail. The oxidised finish enhances depth and gives a worn-in metal character.

name: Floral Cross Crest Ring
shortDescription: A sharp crest ring with a floral cross face and engraved shoulders.
description: A clean gothic crest ring featuring a floral cross emblem with subtle engraved details along the sides. Polished highlights keep the top face crisp and reflective.

name: Full Skull Helm Ring
shortDescription: A statement skull ring with deep sculpting and heavy presence.
description: This skull ring is built for impact: deep shadows, strong contours, and oxidised detailing that makes every sculpted line pop.

name: Curb Chain Cross Band
shortDescription: A chain-textured band fused with a gothic cross centerpiece.
description: A curb-chain texture wraps around the band, anchored by a bold gothic cross element. Designed to feel like metal hardware on the finger.

name: Gothic Cross Cuff
shortDescription: An open cuff bracelet engraved with chrome-style gothic crosses.
description: A solid open cuff featuring engraved gothic cross motifs with oxidised recesses for depth. Adjustable fit with a clean, heavy-metal profile.

name: Skull Link Bracelet
shortDescription: A heavy chain bracelet with skull-link detailing.
description: A chunky bracelet featuring integrated skull elements within a bold chain structure. Oxidised grooves enhance depth and texture.

name: Ornate Scroll Signet Ring
shortDescription: A gothic signet ring with scrollwork framing a cross emblem.
description: This ring combines gothic scroll engravings with a centered cross emblem. Oxidised details add a dark chrome-like contrast around the face.

name: Onyx Gothic Band Ring
shortDescription: A gothic band ring featuring a dark onyx-style centerpiece.
description: A sleek ring designed with a dark centerpiece set into a sharp gothic frame. Polished edges give it a clean chrome shine with a darker mood.

name: Engraved Curb Band Ring
shortDescription: A thick ring with a curb-chain profile and engraved plate detail.
description: A curb-chain inspired ring with a structured plate detail across the face. Oxidised grooves deepen the texture and create a brutalist chrome look.

name: Jaw Skull Ring
shortDescription: A brutal skull ring featuring an aggressive jaw design.
description: A heavier skull ring designed with exaggerated jaw structure and deep shadowed cuts. Made to look raw, violent, and unmistakably gothic.

name: Raw Texture Band Ring
shortDescription: A gritty textured ring with a raw-cast metal look.
description: A rugged band ring with a raw texture that looks sand-cast and worn-in. Oxidised pits and roughness give it an aggressive industrial finish.

name: Gothic Letter Band Ring
shortDescription: A bold band ring featuring raised gothic lettering.
description: A statement band ring with raised gothic lettering across the face. Designed for a clean chrome look with darker recessed detailing for contrast.

name: Gothic Spike Bead Bracelet
shortDescription: A bracelet featuring spiked bead hardware in chrome-style metalwork.
description: A bold bracelet built with hardware-like beads and spiked forms, designed to look like gothic mechanical jewellery. High polish with oxidised shadows for depth.
